end_to_end.expected: Mid-hand Leave table opens the modal 'Leave now? Your hand will be folded.'; play frozen while open; Cancel/Escape resumes with same player to act and no bot action; Confirm folds the user at once (even on a bot's turn), bots finish, record stored with forcedFold:true and no decision for the fold, Session report counts the hand; after a voluntary fold or while all-in Confirm folds nothing more; between hands and before the deal Leave goes straight to the report/Home with no dialog; reload shows no Resume.
end_to_end.actual: All observed as expected in both browsers on the dev server and the built preview. Hand 3 scenario: dialog on my turn, 10 s of fake clock changed nothing, Cancel kept seat and action count; after my call, dialog on a bot's turn held action count for 10 s, Escape returned focus to Leave table with same seat to act; Confirm immediately showed 'Folded', action count +1, same bot to act, Home and Leave table disabled; report focused with 'Cash · 6 players · $4/$8 · 3 hands'; records [1,2,3], hand 3 forcedFold:true, decisions = made actions minus the final fold, no fold decision; hands 1-2 have no forcedFold key; one stored report handsPlayed 3; reload offers no Resume. Already-folded case: dialog shown, Confirm adds no action, report '2 hands', record has no forcedFold and the fold is a decision. All-in case (user stack $4, resumed at hand 25): Confirm adds no action, user not Folded, hand went to showdown, user lost and busted, no bust dialog/Rebuy appeared, report '25 hands', records [25] with no forcedFold, no table header after 5 s. Between hands (Hand over) and before the first deal: no dialog, direct leave.

findings.expected_vs_actual: Known review item, observed: force-folding the seat that holds the top bet leaves currentBet unchanged, so the next seat still faces a call of the folded seat's bet (e.g. seat 3 raises preflop, seat 3 force-folded → seat 4 offered fold / call $8 / raise $12); if only one seat then remains, the folded seat's uncalled part is returned to it. Invariants hold. Not reachable through a user decision; poker-rules question for a follow-up decision task.
findings.fix: Decide the rule in a follow-up task (non-blocking).

findings.expected_vs_actual: Observed with the public forceFold API only: several forced folds in one preflop round (both blinds and others force-folded so the only remaining seat has put in nothing) followed by an ordinary fold leaves checkState reporting 'pot-eligibility: main pot paid seat N, which is not eligible'. The app forces at most one fold per hand (the user's), and with one forced fold per hand 3000 random hands show no violation, so this is not reachable in the product today.
findings.fix: Optional: if forceFold is ever used for more than one seat per hand, the pot eligibility on a fold-out to a non-contributor needs handling (non-blocking).
